golden.json was generated by cosmos-sdk v0.53.6 (the version pokerchain uses): for a fixed private key
(bytes 0x01..0x20), game id, timeout and account number it records the sign bytes, the signature and the
full transaction bytes for five messages. internal/chain/chain_test.go requires the hand-written encoders
to reproduce them byte for byte. Regenerate it only when the chain changes a message or the SDK changes
transaction encoding; the generator was a throwaway test in the pokerchain module (tx builder: SetMsgs,
SetGasLimit(250000), SetUnordered(true), SetTimeoutTimestamp, SIGN_MODE_DIRECT, priv.Sign over the
sign-bytes adapter output).
